description: AI prompts must not contain outcome-conditioned hindsight wording
evidence: Prompt template strictly queries available context at T without outcome adjectives.

description: Test handling of unformatted or missing publication dates
evidence: Fallback assigns UNKNOWN_DATE and excludes from strict temporal matching.

description: Inject future news article with published_at > T
evidence: Firewall rejects article based on information_available_at >= T.

description: Inject future event occurring at T+5
evidence: Filtered strictly prior to decision date T.

description: Test entity resolution on colloquial ticker aliases (e.g. Astra for ASII)
evidence: dim_entity_alias correctly maps aliases to canonical ENT_ASII.

description: Test handling of identical corporate names across sectors
evidence: Unique DuckDB entity_id prevents cross-entity collisions.

description: Test commodity classification on diversified miners (e.g. ANTM Gold vs Nickel)
evidence: Explicit multi-exposure mappings in fact_exposure resolved.

description: Test semantic sentiment on sarcastic market commentary
evidence: AI Selector maps to neutral corporate disclosures rather than editorial sentiment.

description: Test rumor vs confirmed filing classification
evidence: Rumors classified with source_quality='LOW' and lower confidence.

description: Test duplicate news article handling
evidence: Deduplicated by event UUID and canonical source URL hash.

description: Test conflicting reports on corporate action
evidence: AI Selector flags CONTRADICTORY and prompts Red Team review.

description: Test handling of unverified blog post
evidence: Filtered out or assigned source_quality='LOW' with WEAK_RELEVANCE.

description: Test event missing source provenance
evidence: Assigned status UNVERIFIED and barred from primary evidence graph.

description: Test relationship with expired valid_to timestamp
evidence: Valid_to < T checked; stale relationships excluded.

description: Test ticker change or merger restructuring
evidence: Temporal mapping in dim_entity handles valid_from / valid_to transitions.

description: Test stock split announcement timing
evidence: Corporate actions matched with ex-date and publication date PIT.

description: Test unconfirmed buyout rumor
evidence: Assigned information_state='RUMOR' with zero fundamental weight.

description: Test sell-side analyst upgrade vs official disclosure
evidence: Analyst opinions categorized as secondary commentary.

description: Test article analyzing move published after market close
evidence: Available_at timestamp enforces pre-market cutoff.

description: Test weekend retrospective news recap
evidence: Recap timestamped after T is blocked at decision date T.

description: Test text containing 'stock rose 10%'
evidence: Outcome-containing phrases stripped by pre-processor; returns hidden.

description: Test price target speculation
evidence: Price targets filtered from fundamental evidence graph.

description: Test article mentioning future AGM date
evidence: Publication date < T enforced; future AGM noted as future calendar event.

description: Test clickbait headline vs body disclosure
evidence: AI Selector reads structured disclosure body rather than raw headline.

description: Test mismatch between server retrieved_at and official published_at
evidence: Dual timestamp schema enforces both published_at < T and available_at < T.
